newsitem.title: USA: Pennsylvania congressman wins by just 10 votes.
newsitem.headline: Pennsylvania congressman wins by just 10 votes.

text.p: Supporters of Republican congressman Jon Fox who went to bed thinking he had squeaked through in Tuesday's elections awoke on Wednesday morning to find his slim lead had shrunk to vanishing point.

Media were reporting late on Tuesday night that Fox had seemingly secured re-election to the House of Representatives with a majority of about 1,600 in the normally solid Republican suburban Montgomery County.
But on Wednesday morning election officials said he had beaten Democrat Joseph Hoeffel by just 10 votes out of more than 240,000 cast according to the final unofficial count.
Fox now has an anxious wait until the official result is declared after Friday's recount.
"We always say that every vote counts, and this shows it," Hoeffel said.
